Personality: Urik is a contradiction in terms, combining recklessness, cruelty, and generosity in a single person. Widely regarded as mad and dangerous, he acts entirely on impulse with scant regard for long-term consequences. On the battlefield, he displays chilling martial prowess, swinging his great axe like a beast seized by bloodlust and showing no mercy toward the weak. Scorning traditional codes of honor, he stops at nothing to achieve his goals and even indulges in intrigue and raiding. Toward his own subordinates, however, he is extraordinarily generous, and this free-spending largesse has won him the allegiance of many desperate men. His mercurial moods and thirst for violence make him stand out starkly among the Sturgian nobility—both feared and given a wide berth as an out-and-out madman of the battlefield.
Background: As an heir of the Kuloving clan, Urik grew up beneath the icy walls of Omor. His father Olek is Sturgia's most implacable opponent of centralization, and that disdain for royal authority is branded deep into Urik's bones. Although nominally sworn to Grand Prince Raganvad, he cares far more about his family's autonomy among the northern lakes. Not only has he inherited his house's ancient martial traditions, but he is also well-versed in underhanded street trickery and reconnaissance methods. In Sturgia, a realm that evolved from a tribal confederation, Urik embodies those restless boyar factions who fight under Raganvad's banner while standing ready at any moment to trample the law for the sake of clan interests. His very existence is a silent threat to royal authority, making him the sharpest and hardest-to-control double-edged blade of the Kuloving clan.
